points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 华佗出生于东汉末年的谯郡（今安徽亳州），家境贫寒。少年时期，他游学四方，拜师学医，广泛学习古代医学典籍，包括《黄帝内经》、《神农本草经》等。他特别注重实践，经常深入民间，观察各种疾病的治疗方法。这一时期，华佗奠定了扎实的医学基础，形成了自己独特的医学理念，强调预防为主，注重整体调理，对后世中医理论产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Born in the late Eastern Han Dynasty in Qiao Commandery (modern Bozhou, Anhui), Hua Tuo came from a poor family. In his youth, he traveled extensively to study medicine, mastering ancient medical texts such as the Huangdi Neijing and Shennong Ben Cao. He emphasized practical experience, often going among the common people to observe various disease treatments. During this period, Hua Tuo established a solid medical foundation and developed his unique medical philosophy, emphasizing prevention and holistic regulation, which profoundly influenced later Traditional Chinese Medicine theory.

points.title: 医术成名
points.description: 华佗在洛阳行医期间，医术日益精湛，名声远播。他精通内科、外科、妇科、儿科等各科，尤其擅长外科手术。他发明了麻沸散，是世界上最早的麻醉剂之一，能够进行腹部手术。华佗还创编了五禽戏，模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟五种动物的动作，用于强身健体和疾病康复。在洛阳期间，华佗治愈了许多疑难杂症，包括当时被视为不治之症的疾病，赢得了广泛的声誉，被尊为'神医'。
points.descriptionEn: While practicing medicine in Luoyang, Hua Tuo's skills became increasingly refined, and his reputation spread far and wide. He excelled in various medical fields including internal medicine, surgery, gynecology, and pediatrics, particularly known for his surgical expertise. He invented Mafeisan, one of the world's earliest anesthetics, enabling abdominal surgeries. Hua Tuo also created the Five Animals Frolics (Wu Qin Xi), exercises mimicking the movements of five animals (tiger, deer, bear, monkey, and bird) for physical fitness and disease recovery. During his time in Luoyang, he cured many difficult cases, including diseases then considered incurable, earning him widespread acclaim as the 'Divine Physician'.

points.title: 宫廷御医
points.description: 华佗被曹操征召为随军医师，后成为宫廷御医。在许昌期间，他为曹操治疗头风病，但多次建议进行手术治疗，均被曹操拒绝。华佗还曾为关羽刮骨疗毒，展现了高超的外科技术。然而，他与曹操在医疗理念上存在严重分歧，曹操认为华佗借故拖延，意图谋害自己。最终，华佗因不愿继续为曹操服务，谎称妻子生病而请假回家，后被曹操发现真相，将其下狱处死。这一事件成为华佗人生的转折点，也反映了他坚持医德、不畏权贵的品格。
points.descriptionEn: Hua Tuo was summoned by Cao Cao to serve as a military physician and later became a court physician in Xuchang. During this period, he treated Cao Cao's chronic headaches but repeatedly suggested surgery, which Cao refused. Hua Tuo also famously performed bone scraping surgery on Guan Yu, demonstrating exceptional surgical skills. However, he had serious disagreements with Cao Cao regarding medical approaches. Cao accused Hua Tuo of deliberately delaying treatment with the intent to harm him. Eventually, Hua Tuo, unwilling to continue serving Cao Cao, feigned his wife's illness to request leave. When Cao discovered the truth, he had Hua Tuo imprisoned and executed. This event marked a turning point in Hua Tuo's life, reflecting his commitment to medical ethics and his courage in defying authority.

points.place: 沛国谯县（今安徽省亳州市）
points.placeEn: Pei Commandery Qiao County (modern Bozhou, Anhui Province)
points.title: 医学著述
points.description: 在担任宫廷御医期间，华佗利用业余时间整理和总结自己的医学经验，著有多部医学著作，包括《青囊书》、《华佗内方》等。这些著作记录了他的临床经验、药方和手术方法，对后世医学发展有重要影响。可惜的是，这些著作大多已失传，只有部分内容被后人引用和保存。华佗的医学思想强调'治未病'，注重预防疾病，提倡'以人疗人'的整体观念，这些理念至今仍对中医理论产生重要影响。他的医学成就不仅限于治疗疾病，还包括健康养生和疾病预防，体现了中国传统医学的整体观和预防思想。
points.descriptionEn: While serving as court physician, Hua Tuo used his spare time to organize and summarize his medical experiences, authoring several medical works including the Qing Nang Shu and Hua Tuo Nei Fang. These works recorded his clinical experiences, prescriptions, and surgical methods, significantly influencing later medical development. Unfortunately, most of these texts were lost, with only fragments preserved by later scholars. Hua Tuo's medical philosophy emphasized 'treating before illness arises,' focusing on disease prevention and promoting a holistic 'treating people with people' approach. These ideas continue to influence Traditional Chinese Medicine theory today. His medical achievements extended beyond disease treatment to include health preservation and prevention, embodying the holistic and preventive concepts of traditional Chinese medicine.

points.title: 悲剧结局
points.description: 208年，华佗因与曹操的矛盾激化，被下狱处死，享年约63岁。临刑前，他将毕生医学著作《青囊书》交给狱卒，希望流传后世，但狱卒因害怕受牵连而将其焚毁，导致华佗的大部分医学著作失传。华佗的死是中国医学史上的重大损失，他的医学思想和许多独特疗法未能完整保存下来。然而，他的医术和精神却通过弟子和民间传说得以传承。华佗的悲剧结局反映了古代知识分子与权力之间的紧张关系，也彰显了他坚守医德、不畏强权的品格。后世为纪念他，尊称他为'外科鼻祖'，他的故事被广泛流传，成为中国医学史上的传奇人物。
points.descriptionEn: In 208, due to escalating conflicts with Cao Cao, Hua Tuo was imprisoned and executed at approximately age 63. Before his execution, he handed over his life's medical work, the Qing Nang Shu, to a prison guard, hoping it would be passed down to future generations. However, the guard, fearing repercussions, burned the manuscript, resulting in the loss of most of Hua Tuo's medical writings. Hua Tuo's death was a significant loss in Chinese medical history, as his medical ideas and unique treatments were not fully preserved. Nevertheless, his skills and spirit were passed down through his disciples and folk tales. His tragic ending reflected the tension between ancient intellectuals and power, while also demonstrating his commitment to medical ethics and courage in defying authority. Posthumously honored as the 'Father of Surgery,' his story has been widely circulated, making him a legendary figure in Chinese medical history.

supporter.zh: 华佗被誉为'神医'，是中国古代医学的杰出代表。他发明了麻沸散，开创了外科手术的先河；创编五禽戏，开创了医疗体操的先河；强调'治未病'的预防思想，体现了中医的整体观。他的医术精湛，医德高尚，不畏权贵，坚持真理，为后世医学发展奠定了坚实基础。尽管他的大部分著作已失传，但他的医学思想和精神通过弟子和民间传说得以传承，对中国乃至世界医学产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Hua Tuo, revered as the 'Divine Physician,' stands as an outstanding representative of ancient Chinese medicine. He invented Mafeisan, pioneering surgical anesthesia; created the Five Animals Frolics, establishing medical gymnastics; and emphasized preventive healthcare through his 'treat before illness arises' philosophy, embodying the holistic perspective of Traditional Chinese Medicine. With exceptional medical skills and noble ethics, he fearlessly upheld truth against authority, laying a solid foundation for future medical development. Although most of his writings were lost, his medical ideas and spirit have been transmitted through disciples and folklore, exerting profound influence on Chinese and world medicine.

critic.zh: 华佗的医术和成就存在一定程度的神话色彩，部分记载可能被后人夸大。他与曹操的冲突反映了古代医者与统治者的权力关系，也暴露了他在政治判断上的局限性。他的医学著作大多失传，使得后人难以全面评估其真实贡献。此外，他过于依赖个人经验，缺乏系统的理论总结，这在一定程度上限制了他的医学思想的传播和发展。华佗的悲剧结局也警示后人，在坚持专业立场的同时，也需要具备政治智慧，避免不必要的冲突。
critic.en: Hua Tuo's medical skills and achievements contain certain mythological elements, with some accounts possibly exaggerated by later generations. His conflict with Cao Cao reflects the power dynamics between ancient physicians and rulers, revealing limitations in his political judgment. The loss of most of his medical writings makes it difficult for later generations to comprehensively evaluate his actual contributions. Additionally, his over-reliance on personal experience and lack of systematic theoretical summary somewhat limited the dissemination and development of his medical ideas. Hua Tuo's tragic ending serves as a warning that while maintaining professional integrity, political wisdom is also necessary to avoid unnecessary conflicts.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，华佗是中国医学史上承前启后的关键人物，他集古代医学之大成，又开创了多个医学领域的新方向。他的医学实践体现了中国传统医学的整体观和辨证施治的特点，同时也展现了医学与哲学、伦理的紧密联系。在流行文化中，华佗被塑造成医德高尚、医术精湛的完美形象，成为'神医'的代名词。他的故事被广泛传播，影响了后世对医生职业的期待和评价。华佗的生平和成就反映了中国古代医学的发展水平，也体现了知识分子在专制社会中的处境和选择。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Hua Tuo represents a pivotal figure in Chinese medical history, bridging past achievements and opening new directions in multiple medical fields. His medical practice embodied the holistic approach and differential diagnosis characteristic of Traditional Chinese Medicine, while also demonstrating the close connection between medicine, philosophy, and ethics. In popular culture, Hua Tuo has been portrayed as the perfect image of noble character and exceptional medical skill, becoming synonymous with the 'divine physician.' His widely circulated stories have influenced later expectations and evaluations of the medical profession. Hua Tuo's life and achievements reflect the developmental level of ancient Chinese medicine and illustrate the position and choices of intellectuals in an autocratic society.

self.zh: 人体欲得劳动，但不当使极尔。动摇则谷气得消，血脉流通，病不得生。譬如户枢，终不朽也。
self.en: The human body needs exercise, but not to excess. Movement aids digestion, promotes blood circulation, and prevents disease. Just like a door hinge that never rusts from constant use.

others.zh: 华佗之术，妙绝天下，然其志在济世，不在富贵。
others.en: Hua Tuo's medical skills were unparalleled under heaven, yet his ambition was to help the world, not to seek wealth and honor.
